verdict.rationale: Basecamp is a project-management and collaboration SaaS, not a coding agent or browser-automation tool. Having an agent navigate an app it built and capture before-and-after screenshots to verify its own work is outside this product's category. The evidence covers MCP, CLI, Skills and REST API access to Basecamp data, but nothing shows Basecamp itself provides agent-driven app navigation or screenshot verification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent verify its own implementation by navigating the app and capturing before-and-after screenshots
